title: StampRallySettings
description: Stamp rally settings at stampRallySettings/current. Anyone can read; only admins write. Stamps are accepted only while isOpen is true; reward and thanks card redemption ignore it. checkpoints lists the stamp counts required for each prize in ascending order, and its order is the prize number (#1, #2, ...). Without this document the rally is closed and checkpoints default to [7, 14, 22].
